card.name: Word stems just before -ly endings
card.fires_on: The stem of an adverb just before its -ly ending, often in capitalized warning text (IMMEDIATELY, SLOWLY, INTRAVENOUSLY, PARTICULARLY). Also fires on some adjectives like oral, immediate, moderate.

modes.label: Split capitalized adverbs
modes.description: Partway through an all-caps adverb where -ly is still to come.
